articles.제목: Urenco USA marks first commercial LEU+ production
articles.원문 요약: Urenco USA's first cylinder of LEU+ is also the first commercial production of the material in the Western world and ushers in a new era of fuel options, the company says.

articles.제목: Turkey and South Korea explore nuclear financing cooperation
articles.원문 요약: A framework to evaluate potential cooperation on the financing of nuclear power projects was one of a number of energy-related initiatives agreed between Turkey and South Korea.

articles.제목: Singapore enlists Finnish help in bolstering nuclear expertise
articles.원문 요약: The VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland and the Singapore Nuclear Research and Safety Institute have signed a five-year memorandum of understanding to deepen cooperation in nuclear safety and strengthen the capabilities required to assess emerging nuclear technologies.

articles.제목: Rosatom planning new uranium processing plant
articles.원문 요약: A site has been selected, and design work is under way on a processing plant with a capacity of 11,000 tonnes of uranium oxide per year, according to Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom.
